import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import sales_summary

summary = sales_summary.summarize(Path("sales.csv"))
order_count = summary["order_count"]
sys.stderr.write("诊断：已统计 {} 笔真实订单。".format(order_count) + chr(10))
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + chr(10))
